articles.title: New York Times says OpenAI hid evidence in ChatGPT copyright trial
articles.description: News publishers say OpenAI hid tools and datasets that could identify copyrighted journalism in ChatGPT outputs, escalating their lawsuit with a new motion for sanctions.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
articles.description: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue says enterprises increasingly want open models, due to cost, accessibility, and ownership. Do frontier models still matter if most production AI ends up running on open models?
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
articles.description: Apple alleges the misconduct was directed by OpenAI's senior leadership, including a longtime former employee.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Popular open source AI developer tool Ollama raises $65M, grows to nearly 9M users
articles.description: Benchmark-backed Ollama has amassed 176,000 stars, and nearly 17,000 forks on GitHub by helping developers easily run AI on their PCs.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI
articles.description: Of all the debates raging about the potential downsides of AI, there is one worry causing the most hand-wringing among AI enthusiasts in Silicon Valley — that the giant AI labs that sell proprietary models are somehow acting like Trojan horses.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
articles.description: Lyzr, a startup that builds AI agents for enterprises, used its own AI agent to raise a $100 million round — proof, evidently, that the product actually works.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Anthropic, Blackstone bet the next trillion-dollar AI business is implementation, not just models
articles.description: Anthropic-backed Ode launches as AI labs bet that embedding forward-deployed engineers inside enterprises is the key to accelerating enterprise AI adoption.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Vint Cerf is working on a plan to unleash AI agents on the open internet
articles.description: The guy behind TCP/IP is working on a standard for identifying AI agents in the wild.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash
articles.description: "Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way," the company said in a blog post. "We've heard the feedback that this feature missed the mark, so it's no longer available."
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Fidji Simo steps down from OpenAI’s No. 2 role
articles.description: OpenAI's No. 2 executive, Fidji Simo, is stepping down from her full-time role after her medical leave proved longer than expected — a leadership vacuum that comes at a tricky time as the company eyes a possible IPO and races to catch Anthropic in the enterprise market.
articles.author: Connie Loizos
